title: Shoppers at Aldi's 2 Florida grand openings Thursday could win $500 gift cards - NewsBreak
text:
By C. A. Bridges ,
1 days ago
Fresh off launching more than 60 new and converted stores in Florida in 2025, no-frills discount grocery chain Aldi is opening two more on Thursday, Jan. 9, and another two a couple of weeks later.
The new stores this week will be in Chiefland and Port Orange . Stores in Deerfield Beach and Jacksonville open Thursday, Jan. 22, according to the company's coming soon page. Another one listed in Fort Lauderdale has not yet announced a date.
Each location's grand opening will start with an 8:45 a.m. ribbon-cutting ceremony and will include gift bags and gift cards for the first 100 customers. Shoppers can also register to win a sweepstakes for a $500 Aldi gift card at each store.
The Port Orange store quietly opened the week before Christmas but still plans to hold its official grand opening Thursday.
Where are the new Aldi locations opening in Florida? According to the latest dates on Aldi's "Coming Soon" page:
Jan. 8 Chiefland : Chiefland Regional Shopping Center, 2202 North Young Blvd., (former Winn-Dixie) Port Orange : Riverwood Shopping Center, 4025 South Nova Road (former Winn-Dixie) Jan. 22 Deerfield Beach : 2301 W Sample Rd, Building #2 Jacksonville : Cedar Hills Shopping Center, 3538 Blanding Blvd. (former Winn-Dixie) Several more Winn-Dixie conversions in Florida are still ongoing, including locations in Sebastian and Vero Beach , Daytona Beach Shores , DeBary , Fort Lauderdale , another in Jacksonville , Pensacola and more, scheduled for 2026.
Aldi grand openings offer free stuff and a chance to win a $500 gift card At every Aldi grand opening, the first 100 people in line will receive a gift bag of Aldi-exclusive products and a gift card for $10, $25 or $100 as part of the discount grocer's Golden Ticket program. All shoppers can get a free Aldi shopping tote, while supplies last, just look for an Aldi employee and ask.
Shoppers can register from the morning the new location opens through the weekend for a chance to win a $500 gift card, no purchase necessary. Registration at all new locations ends at 8 p.m. the Sunday after the grand opening.
Grab your shopping carts: Publix, Aldi, Winn-Dixie, more Florida grocery stores opening in 2026
Florida sees explosion of Aldis in 2025 The openings follow a hectic December for Aldi in Florida, which saw doors open in Bradenton, Bushnell, Homosassa, Lakeland, Leesburg, North Fort Myers, Ormond Beach , two in Port Charlotte, Port Saint John, Saint Johns, Sarasota, Seminole, Tampa and Venice.
During the year, the German-based chain famous for low prices and store-brand goods (and a complete lack of coupons, in-store delis, bakeries, pharmacies, loyalty programs, baggers or Muzak) opened 62 locations in the Sunshine State.
The chain's announced plan was to open 225 new stores nationwide in 2025, with plans for 800 locations by the end of 2028. A comparison of their store listings from Jan. 5, 2026 , and Jan. 1, 2025 , suggests they opened 167.
Many of the new Florida locations were converted Winn-Dixie locations from Aldi's brief acquisition of that company in 2024-2025.
Other grocery chains expanding in Florida The other grocery chains in Florida also have Florida plans.
Bravo: The New York-based Latin grocery chain Bravo opened an Ocala location last year and has another planned for Clermont in 2026 Publix: The Florida chain will continue to open and/or retrofit existing locations into its new, larger format, with at least 11 stores in progress and a St. Augustine location opening Jan. 15 Sprouts: The Arizona-based upscale grocery chain specializing in fresh, natural and organic food opened eight locations in Florida last year and has plans to open at least three more Trader Joe's: After opening two Florida locations last year, the company announced 10 more coming to eight states but no Florida locations have been announced Winn-Dixie: After hitting its 100th anniversary, getting bought out by Aldi, forming a new company and buying most of its locations back, Winn-Dixie is ready to focus on Florida with community-friendly renovations to existing stores and expansion Where can I find an Aldi near me in Florida? There are currently 286 Aldi locations in Florida. You can find the list at stores.aldi.us/fl .
C. A. Bridges is a journalist for the USA TODAY Network-Florida's service journalism Connect team. You can get all of Florida’s best content directly in your inbox each weekday day by signing up for the free newsletter, Florida TODAY .
